review.label: NON_EQUIVALENT
review.rationale: The overlay replaces a conditional guard `if data.proposal_consumed_thss and data.source_snapshot_id is None:` with `if False:`, which unconditionally disables the branch. Any execution path where `data.proposal_consumed_thss` is truthy and `data.source_snapshot_id` is None would previously have entered the branch and executed its body; after the mutation, that body is never executed regardless of input values. This produces an observable behavioral difference: the guarded logic (error raising, state mutation, response modification, or other side effects within the branch) is suppressed for all inputs that would have satisfied the original condition.
